title: A perfect proper pushforward of a perfect complex on a Noetherian space is perfect
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For Y Noetherian over S and f : X -> Y a perfect proper morphism of algebraic spaces, Rf_*E is perfect in D(O_Y) for every perfect E in D(O_X). The retained proof verifies the three hypotheses of Derived Categories of Spaces, perfect-direct-image: (1), (2) immediate, (3) local on X, checked affine with E strictly perfect, reducing via spaces-perfect-lemma-tor-dimension-rel (etale-to-Zariski tor dimension) to schemes-perfect-lemma 'finite tor dimension as f^{-1}O_Y-modules' which for finite type scheme maps is perfection (More on Morphisms, check-perfect-stalks). Retained author proof at lines 11101-11114.
